verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה דִּבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הָאַֽחֲרֹנִ֑ים נְאֻ֧ם דָּוִ֣ד בֶּן־ יִשַׁ֗י וּנְאֻ֤ם הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ הֻ֣קַם עָ֔ל מְשִׁ֙יחַ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּנְעִ֖ים זְמִר֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh diḇ·rê ḏā·wiḏ hā·’a·ḥă·rō·nîm nə·’um dā·wiḏ ben- yi·šay ū·nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer hu·qam ‘āl mə·šî·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·nə·‘îm zə·mi·rō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: These are the last words of David The oracle of David son of Jesse the oracle of the man raised on high the one anointed by the God of Jacob and the sweet psalmist of Israel
verses.literalPt: E ESTAS são as últimas palavras de Davi: Diz Davi, filho de Jessé, e diz o homem que foi levantado em altura, o ungido do Deus de Jacó, e o suave em salmos de Israel.

verses.original: ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּר־ בִּ֑י וּמִלָּת֖וֹ עַל־ לְשׁוֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ Yah·weh dib·ber- bî ū·mil·lā·ṯōw ‘al- lə·šō·w·nî
verses.literal: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me His word was on my tongue
verses.literalPt: O Espírito do SENHOR falou por mim, e a sua palavra está na minha boca.

verses.original: אָמַר֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ֥י דִבֶּ֖ר צ֣וּר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מוֹשֵׁל֙ בָּאָדָ֔ם צַדִּ֕יק מוֹשֵׁ֖ל יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lî ḏib·ber ṣūr yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šêl bā·’ā·ḏām ṣad·dîq mō·wō·šêl yir·’aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: The God of Israel spoke the Rock of Israel said to me He who rules the people with justice who rules in the fear of God
verses.literalPt: Disse o Deus de Israel, a Rocha de Israel a mim me falou: Haverá um justo que domine sobre os homens, que domine no temor de Deus.

verses.original: וּכְא֥וֹר בֹּ֖קֶר יִזְרַח־ שָׁ֑מֶשׁ בֹּ֚קֶר לֹ֣א עָב֔וֹת מִנֹּ֥גַהּ מִמָּטָ֖ר דֶּ֥שֶׁא מֵאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·’ō·wr bō·qer yiz·raḥ- šā·meš bō·qer lō ‘ā·ḇō·wṯ min·nō·ḡah mim·mā·ṭār de·še mê·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: is like the light of the morning at sunrise . . . of a cloudless . . . dawn the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth
verses.literalPt: E será como a luz da manhã, quando sai o sol, da manhã sem nuvens, quando pelo seu resplendor e pela chuva a erva brota da terra.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לֹא־ כֵ֥ן בֵּיתִ֖י עִם־ אֵ֑ל כִּי֩ בְרִ֨ית עוֹלָ֜ם שָׂ֣ם לִ֗י עֲרוּכָ֤ה בַכֹּל֙ וּשְׁמֻרָ֔ה כִּֽי־ כָל־ יִשְׁעִ֥י וְכָל־ חֵ֖פֶץ כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א יַצְמִֽיחַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lō- ḵên bê·ṯî ‘im- ’êl kî ḇə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām śām lî ‘ă·rū·ḵāh ḇak·kōl ū·šə·mu·rāh kî- ḵāl yiš·‘î wə·ḵāl ḥê·p̄eṣ kî- lō yaṣ·mî·aḥ
verses.literal: Is not my house right with God For He has established with me an everlasting covenant ordered and secured . . . in every part Will He not bring about my full salvation and my every desire . . .
verses.literalPt: Ainda que a minha casa não seja tal para com Deus, contudo estabeleceu comigo uma aliança eterna, que em tudo será bem ordenado e guardado, pois toda a minha salvação e todo o meu prazer está nele, apesar de que ainda não o faz brotar.

verses.original: וּבְלִיַּ֕עַל כְּק֥וֹץ מֻנָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֑הַם כִּֽי־ לֹ֥א בְיָ֖ד יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·lî·ya·‘al kə·qō·wṣ mu·nāḏ kul·lā·ham kî- lō ḇə·yāḏ yiq·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside for they can never be gathered by hand
verses.literalPt: Porém os filhos de Belial todos serão como os espinhos que se lançam fora, porque não podem ser tocados com a mão.

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ יִגַּ֣ע בָּהֶ֔ם יִמָּלֵ֥א בַרְזֶ֖ל וְעֵ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית וּבָאֵ֕שׁ שָׂר֥וֹף יִשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בַּשָּֽׁבֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš yig·ga‘ bā·hem yim·mā·lê ḇar·zel wə·‘êṣ ḥă·nîṯ ū·ḇā·’êš śā·rō·wp̄ yiś·śā·rə·p̄ū baš·šā·ḇeṯ
verses.literal: The man who touches them must be armed with iron or with the shaft of a spear The fire burns them to ashes . . . in the place where they lie
verses.literalPt: Mas qualquer que os tocar se armará de ferro e da haste de uma lança; e a fogo serão totalmente queimados no mesmo lugar.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת הַגִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְדָוִ֑ד יֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּשֶּׁ֜בֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִ֣י׀ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׁלִשִׁ֗י ה֚וּא עֲדִינ֣וֹ הָעֶצְנוֹ עַל־ שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֛וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּפַ֥עַם אֶחָד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hag·gib·bō·rîm ’ă·šer lə·ḏā·wiḏ yō·šêḇ baš·še·ḇeṯ taḥ·kə·mō·nî rōš haš·šā·li·šî hū ‘ă·ḏî·nōw hå̄·ʿɛṣ·nō ‘al- šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl bə·p̄a·‘am ʾɛ·ḥå̄ḏ
verses.literal: These are the names of David’s mighty men Josheb-basshebeth . . . the Tahchemonite was chief of the Three He wielded his spear against eight hundred men whom he killed at one time
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos poderosos que Davi teve: Josebe-Bassebete, filho de Taquemoni, o principal dos capitães; este era Adino, o eznita, que se opusera a oitocentos, e os feriu de uma vez.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרוֹ אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן־ דֹּדִי בֶּן־ אֲחֹחִ֑י בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה גִבֹּרִים עִם־ דָּוִ֗ד בְּחָֽרְפָ֤ם בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ־ שָׁ֣ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾa·ḥă·rō ’el·‘ā·zār ben- dō·ḏī ben- ’ă·ḥō·ḥî biš·lō·šāh ḡib·bō·rīm ‘im- dā·wiḏ bə·ḥā·rə·p̄ām bap·pə·liš·tîm ne·’es·p̄ū- šām lam·mil·ḥā·māh way·ya·‘ă·lū ’îš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite As one of the three mighty men he went with David to taunt the Philistines who had gathered for battle at Pas-dammim The men of Israel retreated
verses.literalPt: E depois dele Eleazar, filho de Dodó, filho de Aoí, entre os três valentes que estavam com Davi quando provocaram os filisteus que ali se ajuntaram à peleja, e quando se retiraram os homens de Israel.

verses.original: ה֣וּא קָם֩ וַיַּ֨ךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים עַ֣ד׀ כִּֽי־ יָגְעָ֣ה יָד֗וֹ וַתִּדְבַּ֤ק יָדוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְהָעָ֛ם יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אַחֲרָ֖יו אַךְ־ לְפַשֵּֽׁט׃ס
verses.transliteration: hū qām way·yaḵ bap·pə·liš·tîm ‘aḏ kî- yā·ḡə·‘āh yā·ḏōw wat·tiḏ·baq yā·ḏōw ’el- ha·ḥe·reḇ way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh tə·šū·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·hā·‘ām yā·šu·ḇū ’a·ḥă·rāw ’aḵ- lə·p̄aš·šêṭ
verses.literal: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck the Philistines until . . . his hand grew weary and stuck . . . to his sword The LORD brought about a great victory that day Then the troops returned to him but only to plunder the dead
verses.literalPt: Este se levantou, e feriu os filisteus, até lhe cansar a mão e ficar a mão pegada à espada; e naquele dia o SENHOR efetuou um grande livramento; e o povo voltou junto dele, somente a tomar o despojo.

verses.original: וְאַחֲרָ֛יו שַׁמָּ֥א בֶן־ אָגֵ֖א הָרָרִ֑י וַיֵּאָסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַחַיָּ֗ה וַתְּהִי־ שָׁ֞ם חֶלְקַ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְהָעָ֥ם נָ֖ס מִפְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rāw šam·mā ḇen- ’ā·ḡê hā·rā·rî way·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū p̄ə·liš·tîm la·ḥay·yāh wat·tə·hî- šām ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh mə·lê·’āh ‘ă·ḏā·šîm wə·hā·‘ām nās mip·pə·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: And after him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite When the Philistines had banded together near - a field . . . full of lentils Israel’s troops fled from them
verses.literalPt: E depois dele Samá, filho de Agé, o hararita, quando os filisteus se ajuntaram numa multidão, onde havia um pedaço de terra cheio de lentilhas, e o povo fugira de diante dos filisteus.

verses.original: וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֤ב בְּתוֹךְ־ הַֽחֶלְקָה֙ וַיַּצִּילֶ֔הָ וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ- ha·ḥel·qāh way·yaṣ·ṣî·le·hā way·yaḵ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm way·ya·‘aś Yah·weh tə·šū·‘āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh
verses.literal: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field defended it and struck down the Philistines So the LORD brought about a great victory
verses.literalPt: Este, pois, se pôs no meio daquele pedaço de terra, e o defendeu, e feriu os filisteus; e o SENHOR efetuou um grande livramento.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֨וּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵהַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים רֹ֗אשׁ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל־ קָצִיר֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד אֶל־ מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וְחַיַּ֣ת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū šə·lō·šīm mê·haš·šə·lō·šîm rōš way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- qā·ṣîr ’el- dā·wiḏ ’el- mə·‘ā·raṯ ‘ă·ḏul·lām wə·ḥay·yaṯ pə·liš·tîm ḥō·nāh bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: At harvest time three of the thirty chief men went down . . . to David at the cave of Adullam while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim
verses.literalPt: Também três dos trinta chefes desceram, e no tempo da sega foram a Davi, à caverna de Adulão; e a multidão dos filisteus acampara no vale de Refaim.

verses.original: וְדָוִ֖ד אָ֣ז בַּמְּצוּדָ֑ה וּמַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·wiḏ ’āz bam·mə·ṣū·ḏāh ū·maṣ·ṣaḇ pə·liš·tîm ’āz bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: At that time David was in the stronghold and the garrison of the Philistines . . . was at Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Davi estava então num lugar forte, e a guarnição dos filisteus em Belém.

verses.original: וַיִּתְאַוֶּ֥ה דָוִ֖ד וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣נִי מַ֔יִם מִבֹּ֥אר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·’aw·weh ḏā·wiḏ way·yō·mar mî yaš·qê·nî ma·yim mib·bōr bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ă·šer baš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: David longed for water and said Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: E teve Davi desejo, e disse: Quem me dera beber da água da cisterna de Belém, que está junto à porta!

verses.original: וַיִּבְקְעוּ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִ֜ים בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִבֹּ֤אר בֵּֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשַּׁ֔עַר וַיִּשְׂא֖וּ וַיָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֑ד וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֔ם וַיַּסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·qə·‘ū šə·lō·šeṯ hag·gib·bō·rîm bə·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yiš·’ă·ḇū- ma·yim mib·bōr bêṯ- le·ḥem ’ă·šer baš·ša·‘ar way·yiś·’ū way·yā·ḇi·’ū ’el- dā·wiḏ wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh liš·tō·w·ṯām way·yas·sêḵ ’ō·ṯām Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp drew water from the well near the gate . . . of Bethlehem and brought it back to David But he refused . . . to drink it instead , he poured it out to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então aqueles três poderosos romperam pelo arraial dos filisteus, e tiraram água da cisterna de Belém, que está junto à porta, e a tomaram, e a trouxeram a Davi; porém ele não a quis beber, mas derramou-a perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָה֩ לִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה מֵעֲשֹׂ֣תִי זֹ֗את הֲדַ֤ם הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ הַהֹלְכִ֣ים בְּנַפְשׁוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִשְׁתּוֹתָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥā·lî·lāh lî Yah·weh mê·‘ă·śō·ṯî zōṯ hă·ḏam hā·’ă·nā·šîm ha·hō·lə·ḵîm bə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯām wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh liš·tō·w·ṯām ’êl·leh ‘ā·śū šə·lō·šeṯ hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: saying Far be it from me O LORD to do this Is this not the blood of the men . . . who risked their lives So he refused . . . to drink it Such were the exploits of the three mighty men
verses.literalPt: E disse: Guarda-me, ó SENHOR, de que tal faça; beberia eu o sangue dos homens que foram com risco da sua vida? De maneira que não a quis beber; isto fizeram aqueles três poderosos.

verses.original: וַאֲבִישַׁ֞י אֲחִ֣י׀ יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֗ה ה֚וּא רֹ֣אשׁ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁי וְהוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת־ חֲנִית֔וֹ עַל־ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בַּשְּׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḇî·šay ’ă·ḥî yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh hū rōš haš·šə·lō·šī wə·hū ‘ō·w·rêr ’eṯ- ḥă·nî·ṯōw ‘al- šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥā·lāl wə·lōw- šêm baš·šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: Now Abishai the brother of Joab and son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three and he wielded his spear against three hundred men killed them and won a name along with the Three
verses.literalPt: Também Abisai, irmão de Joabe, filho de Zeruia, era chefe de três; e este alçou a sua lança contra trezentos e os feriu; e tinha nome entre os três.

verses.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁה֙ הֲכִ֣י נִכְבָּ֔ד וַיְהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לְשָׂ֑ר וְעַד־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָֽא׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šə·lō·šāh hă·ḵî niḵ·bāḏ way·hî lā·hem lə·śār wə·‘aḏ- haš·šə·lō·šāh lō- ḇā
verses.literal: Was he not more honored than the Three And he became their commander . . . even though he was not included among the Three
verses.literalPt: Porventura este não era o mais nobre dentre estes três? Pois era o primeiro deles; porém aos primeiros três não chegou.

verses.original: וּבְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן־ אִֽישׁ־ חַי רַב־ פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽקַּבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְהִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת־ הָאֲרִיַּה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַבֹּ֖אר בְּי֥וֹם הַשָּֽׁלֶג׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- ’îš- ḥay raḇ- pə·‘ā·lîm miq·qaḇ·ṣə·’êl hū hik·kāh ’êṯ šə·nê ’ă·ri·’êl mō·w·’āḇ wə·hū yā·raḏ wə·hik·kāh ’eṯ- hå̄·ʾă·rī·yah bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·bōr bə·yō·wm haš·šā·leḡ
verses.literal: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel a man of many exploits He struck down two champions of Moab and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion
verses.literalPt: Também Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho de um homem valoroso de Cabzeel, grande em obras, este feriu dois fortes heróis de Moabe; e desceu ele, e feriu um leão no meio duma cova, no tempo da neve.

verses.original: וְהוּא־ הִכָּה֩ אֶת־ אִ֨ישׁ מִצְרִ֜י אֲשֶׁר מַרְאֶ֗ה וּבְיַ֤ד הַמִּצְרִי֙ חֲנִ֔ית וַיֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖יו בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט וַיִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת־ הַחֲנִית֙ מִיַּ֣ד הַמִּצְרִ֔י וַיַּהַרְגֵ֖הוּ בַּחֲנִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū- hik·kāh ’eṯ- ’îš miṣ·rî ʾă·šɛr mar·’eh ū·ḇə·yaḏ ham·miṣ·rî ḥă·nîṯ way·yê·reḏ ’ê·lāw baš·šā·ḇeṭ way·yiḡ·zōl ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·nîṯ mî·yaḏ ham·miṣ·rî way·ya·har·ḡê·hū ba·ḥă·nî·ṯōw
verses.literal: He also struck down an Egyptian a huge man Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand Benaiah went against him with a club snatched the spear from his hand and killed the Egyptian with his own spear
verses.literalPt: Também este feriu um egípcio, homem de respeito; e na mão do egípcio havia uma lança, porém ele desceu a ele com um cajado, e arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio, e com ela o matou.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְלוֹ־ שֵׁ֖ם בִּשְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה הַגִּבֹּרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ‘ā·śāh bə·nā·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ wə·lōw- šêm biš·lō·šāh hag·gib·bō·rîm
verses.literal: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada who won a name along with the three mighty men
verses.literalPt: Estas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada, pelo que teve nome entre três poderosos.

verses.original: מִן־ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים נִכְבָּ֔ד וְאֶל־ הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא־ בָ֑א וַיְשִׂמֵ֥הוּ דָוִ֖ד אֶל־ מִשְׁמַעְתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: min- haš·šə·lō·šîm niḵ·bāḏ wə·’el- haš·šə·lō·šāh lō- ḇā way·śi·mê·hū ḏā·wiḏ ’el- miš·ma‘·tōw
verses.literal: He was most honored among the Thirty but he did not become one of the Three And David appointed him over his guard
verses.literalPt: Dentre os trinta ele era o mais nobre, porém aos três primeiros não chegou; e Davi o pôs sobre os seus guardas.

verses.original: עֲשָׂה־ אֵ֥ל אֲחִֽי־ יוֹאָ֖ב בַּשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ דֹּד֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ’ă·ḥî- yō·w·’āḇ baš·šə·lō·šîm ’el·ḥā·nān ben- dō·ḏōw bêṯ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Now these were members of the Thirty Asahel the brother of Joab Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem
verses.literalPt: Asael, irmão de Joabe, estava entre os trinta; El-Hanã, filho de Dodó, de Belém;

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽחֲרֹדִ֔י אֱלִיקָ֖א הַחֲרֹדִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: šam·māh ha·ḥă·rō·ḏî ’ĕ·lî·qā ha·ḥă·rō·ḏî
verses.literal: Shammah the Harodite Elika the Harodite
verses.literalPt: Samá, harodita; Elica, harodita;

verses.original: חֶ֚לֶץ הַפַּלְטִ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥe·leṣ hap·pal·ṭî ‘î·rā ḇen- ‘iq·qêš hat·tə·qō·w·‘î
verses.literal: Helez the Paltite Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite
verses.literalPt: Helez, paltita; Ira, filho de Iques, tecoíta;

verses.original: אֲבִיעֶ֙זֶר֙ הָֽעַנְּתֹתִ֔י מְבֻנַּ֖י הַחֻשָׁתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer hā·‘an·nə·ṯō·ṯî mə·ḇun·nay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî
verses.literal: Abiezer the Anathothite Mebunnai the Hushathite
verses.literalPt: Abiezer, anatotita; Mebunai, husatita;

verses.original: צַלְמוֹן֙ הָֽאֲחֹחִ֔י מַהְרַ֖י הַנְּטֹפָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣal·mō·wn hā·’ă·ḥō·ḥî mah·ray han·nə·ṭō·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Zalmon the Ahohite Maharai the Netophathite
verses.literalPt: Zalmom, aoíta; Maarai, netofatita;

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶב בֶּֽן־ בַּעֲנָ֖ה הַנְּטֹפָתִ֑יס אִתַּי֙ בֶּן־ רִיבַ֔י מִגִּבְעַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·leḇ ben- ba·‘ă·nāh han·nə·ṭō·p̄å̄·ṯīs ’it·tay ben- rî·ḇay mig·giḇ·‘aṯ bə·nê ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites . . .
verses.literalPt: Elebe, filho de Baaná, netofatita; Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gibeá dos filhos de Benjamim;

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ פִּרְעָ֣תֹנִ֔י הִדַּ֖י מִנַּ֥חֲלֵי גָֽעַשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nā·yā·hū pir·‘ā·ṯō·nî hid·day min·na·ḥă·lê ḡā·‘aš
verses.literal: Benaiah the Pirathonite Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash
verses.literalPt: Benaia, piratonita; Hidai, do ribeiro de Gaás;

verses.original: אֲבִֽי־ עַלְבוֹן֙ הָֽעַרְבָתִ֔י עַזְמָ֖וֶת הַבַּרְחֻמִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇî- ‘al·ḇō·wn hā·‘ar·ḇā·ṯî ‘az·mā·weṯ hab·bar·ḥu·mî
verses.literal: Abi-albon the Arbathite Azmaveth the Barhumite
verses.literalPt: Abi-Albom, arbatita; Azmavete, barumita;

verses.original: אֶלְיַחְבָּא֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַלְבֹנִ֔י בְּנֵ֥י יָשֵׁ֖ן יְהוֹנָתָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’el·yaḥ·bā haš·ša·‘al·ḇō·nî bə·nê yā·šên yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān
verses.literal: Eliahba the Shaalbonite the sons of Jashen Jonathan
verses.literalPt: Eliaba, saalbonita; os filhos de Jásen e Jônatas;

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽהֲרָרִ֔י אֲחִיאָ֥ם בֶּן־ שָׁרָ֖ר הָארָרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: šam·māh ha·hă·rā·rî ’ă·ḥî·’ām ben- šā·rār hā·rā·rî
verses.literal: son of Shammah the Hararite Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite
verses.literalPt: Samá, hararita, Aião, filho de Sarar, ararita;

verses.original: אֱלִיפֶ֥לֶט בֶּן־ אֲחַסְבַּ֖י בֶּן־ הַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑יס אֱלִיעָ֥ם בֶּן־ אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל הַגִּלֹנִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lî·p̄e·leṭ ben- ’ă·ḥas·bay ben- ham·ma·ʿă·ḵå̄·ṯīs ’ĕ·lî·‘ām ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṯō·p̄el hag·gi·lō·nî
verses.literal: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite
verses.literalPt: Elifelete, filho de Aasbai, filho de um maacatita; Eliã, filho de Aitofel, gilonita;

verses.original: חֶצְרוֹ הַֽכַּרְמְלִ֔י פַּעֲרַ֖י הָאַרְבִּֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥɛṣ·rō hak·kar·mə·lî pa·‘ă·ray hā·’ar·bî
verses.literal: Hezro the Carmelite Paarai the Arbite
verses.literalPt: Hesrai, carmelita; Paarai, arbita;

verses.original: יִגְאָ֤ל בֶּן־ נָתָן֙ מִצֹּבָ֔הס בָּנִ֖י הַגָּדִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: yiḡ·’āl ben- nā·ṯān miṣ·ṣō·ḇå̄·hs bā·nî hag·gā·ḏî
verses.literal: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah Bani the Gadite
verses.literalPt: Igal, filho de Natã, de Zobá; Bani, gadita;

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָעַמֹּנִ֑יס נַחְרַי֙ הַבְּאֵ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵי כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרֻיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ṣe·leq hå̄·ʿam·mō·nīs naḥ·ray hab·bə·’ê·rō·ṯî nō·śə·ʾē kə·lê yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·ru·yāh
verses.literal: Zelek the Ammonite Naharai the Beerothite the armor-bearer . . . of Joab son of Zeruiah
verses.literalPt: Zeleque, amonita; Naarai, beerotita, o que trazia as armas de Joabe, filho de Zeruia;

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַיִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַיִּתְרִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘î·rā hay·yiṯ·rî gā·rêḇ hay·yiṯ·rî
verses.literal: Ira the Ithrite Gareb the Ithrite
verses.literalPt: Ira, itrita; Garebe, itrita;

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י כֹּ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ū·rî·yāh ha·ḥit·tî kōl šə·lō·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: and Uriah the Hittite There were thirty-seven . . . in all
verses.literalPt: Urias, heteu; trinta e sete ao todo.
